checks: Selection recomputed from corrected complete comparator audit: largest/lower-median/smallest trajectory gain, deterministic ID ties, exact saved first handle, with adverse cases retained.
DROID uses original development cases and archived AR/bounded predictions, plus separately trained completed no-tanh components; does not relabel AR as strongest DROID control.

IWS uses completed official reserved validation population and unchanged recovery-v2 rowwise loader, CPU FP32, eight intra-op threads, one inter-op thread, batch one, exact native command/target offsets.
All seeds use identical source/target coordinates and feature normalization; normalized scorer targets do not enter predictor calls.
Per-seed squared errors, M=(1-g)I+gT, and correction RMS are calculated before averaging. No products of averaged gates/weights; no error of mean forecast.
Learned source weights are not semantic attention, saliency, optical flow, confidence or causal attribution; increased diagonal retention is algebraic.
Fixed ledger and algebra tolerances abort on mismatch with no case/backend/tolerance fallback. Returned-detail and public predictions require exact equality.
Registered source and selected payload hashes rechecked before and after replay; immutable local manifest committed only after complete checks.
Public export requires independent completed-result receipt and includes derived numerical JSON only; new raw frames/features/commands/predictions remain local.
limitations: Source clearance is not a claim that actual replay will pass fixed B1 versus B64 ledger tolerances or derived algebra checks.
Deferred payload bindings were inspected as metadata only; the gated harness must verify actual bytes before use.
Posthoc case/rank comparisons remain descriptive and do not change the registered primary method or training/checkpoint selection.
rights_scope: DROID attribution applies. IWS dataset license is unspecified; the associated model-card license is not treated as a dataset grant. Parent-authorized limited low-resolution attributed research excerpts may be embedded in annotated figures; this review does not authorize standalone raw-data distribution.
scope: Pre-execution independent source, metadata identity and synthetic-contract review; no replay, dataset/cache/ledger array decoding, predictor loading, image decoding or new accuracy inference by reviewer. Execution and public-derived-pack release require a separate completed result review.
